abstract: Surveys carrier alternative fuel adoption and fleet carbon efficiency metrics
system_message:
You are the Sustainability and environmental compliance lead (SEC), responsible for surveying carrier alternative fuel adoption and fleet carbon efficiency metrics across pharmaceutical distributor proposals.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Depot renewable energy share（SOLAR）
information_points.content:
SEC-SOLAR-G6W：For Helvetia Pharma Express AG, the energy management audit statement for primary cross-dock hub facility operations confirms a distribution center solar generation fraction of 35% of annual warehouse electrical load offset through on-site solar photovoltaic panels.
SEC-SOLAR-40L：The energy management audit statement regarding primary cross-dock hub facility operations shows that Nordic BioPharma Freight AB records a distribution center solar generation fraction of 20% of its annual warehouse electrical load offset by on-site solar photovoltaic panels.
SEC-SOLAR-NVQ：Based on the energy management audit statement for primary cross-dock hub facility operations, AeroMed Logistique S.A.S. achieves a distribution center solar generation fraction of 50%, representing the annual warehouse electrical load offset by on-site solar photovoltaic panels.

information_points.title: Surveys carrier alternative fuel adoption and fleet carbon efficiency metrics（ECO）
information_points.content:
SEC-ECO-EU7：According to the fleet green logistics survey covering the total urban and regional delivery truck fleet, AeroMed Logistique S.A.S. maintains a biofuel and electric fleet adoption share of 45%, reflecting operational vehicles powered by hydrotreated vegetable oil or battery-electric drivetrains.
SEC-ECO-X6P：Helvetia Pharma Express AG demonstrates a biofuel and electric fleet adoption share of 45% of its total urban and regional delivery truck fleet in the fleet green logistics survey evaluating hydrotreated vegetable oil and battery-electric drivetrains.
SEC-ECO-BTR：The fleet green logistics survey for Nordic BioPharma Freight AB indicates a biofuel and electric fleet adoption share of 70% across its total urban and regional delivery truck fleet powered by hydrotreated vegetable oil or battery-electric drivetrains.
